items.title: 83:44 · In physics and linear algebra a scalar
items.detail: In physics and linear algebra, a scalar is a quantity possessing magnitude alone, such as temperature or speed, whereas a vector possesses both magnitude and a specific spatial direction, such as force or velocity.
